items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1969-12-30
items.q: we'd do little funny tricks on him and he would get mad and he'd blow his stack and he'd be alright after

ctx.x: Just anything that he did that would be funny. Oh you mean Scott?

Yeah. No, he was a fella that couldn't take kiddin' so much and I was a young boy and we'd do little funny tricks on him and he would get mad and he'd blow his stack and he'd be alright after. But that was the nickname, Funnies.
